correctness.rationale: For each integer \(n\geq3\), all nonedges have distance two. The exact forbidden-triple test yields a path join with the specified edges and two exceptional triangles. Their matched-pair edges are free, so two elementary collapses leave the contractible path join with exactly \(n-1\) attached one-cells. The CW quotient is a wedge of \(n-1\) circles integrally. Independent breadth-first search, complete face enumeration, and \(\mathbb F_2\) chain computations for \(3\leq n\leq8\) corroborate the all-parameter proof.

value.rationale: Deleting one edge from a vertex-transitive multipartite family changes the homotopy type from an \(n-1\)-sphere plus \(n\) circles to just \(n-1\) circles for every \(n\geq3\). The homotopy dimension collapses from unbounded dimension to one, while the first Betti number drops by one. This natural sharp edge-instability boundary is mathematically motivated and established by an explicit uniform collapse, not a finite census.
